description: Minimal geometric abstract form built from Brad's signature black (#232323) and red (#FF414C) palette. One shared linearGradient (grad-shared) fills all three shapes — highlight diamond, right solid overlay, left solid overlay — guaranteeing color continuity across the composition at all times. The gradient transfuses from a permanent dark anchor (stop 0%) to a pulsing red tip (stop 100%) driven by a single pulse-a timing. Motion variety comes purely from three independent opacity breath speeds (pulse-fast, pulse-mid, pulse-slow) with phase offsets (offset-mid, offset-slow) so no two shapes peak simultaneously. The two solid base fills remain ${color-main} and never animate — only their gradient overlay layers breathe.

palette_groups.note: Core dark brand tones centered on #232323. Used as the permanent gradient stop-0 anchor and as the solid base fill for both solid paths. Tight entropy — must stay dark for brand legibility.
Vibrant red brand tones centered on #FF414C. Used as the animated stop-100 target in grad-shared. Low entropy — stays within vivid Pantone-adjacent red.

motion_groups.note: Master color cycle on grad-shared stop-100. ONE value controls when red appears and recedes across the entire composition. All three paths see this color change simultaneously — this is the transfusion heartbeat.
Opacity breath for the highlight diamond (Path 1). Fastest — the diamond is the smallest and most focal shape, benefits from the most animation energy. No phase offset; sets the downbeat.
Opacity breath for the right solid gradient overlay (Path 2). Mid tempo. offset-mid staggers it from the diamond.
Opacity breath for the left solid gradient overlay (Path 3). Slowest — largest shape, grounding anchor. offset-slow phases it further from both other shapes.
begin delays that stagger Path 2 and Path 3 from Path 1, ensuring no two shapes are at opacity peak simultaneously.

vars.name: color-main
vars.note: Dark brand anchor. Permanent stop-0 in grad-shared and solid base fill. Canonical #232323.

vars.name: color-accent
vars.note: Red brand accent. Animated stop-100 target in grad-shared — the destination of every transfusion. Canonical #FF414C.

vars.name: alpha-lo
vars.note: stop-opacity floor on grad-shared stop-100. The exhale state — red tip nearly invisible. Applies to all paths simultaneously since it lives in the gradient definition.

vars.name: alpha-hi
vars.note: stop-opacity ceiling on grad-shared stop-100. The inhale peak — red tip fully present. Applies to all paths simultaneously.

vars.name: alpha-bleed-lo
vars.note: Opacity floor for the solid path gradient overlay animations (Path 2 and Path 3). Keeps the bleed nearly invisible at rest.

vars.name: alpha-bleed-hi
vars.note: Opacity ceiling for the solid path gradient overlay animations. Controls how strongly the red bleeds into the solid shapes at peak.

vars.name: opacity-lo
vars.note: Opacity floor for Path 1 (highlight diamond) breath animation.

vars.name: opacity-hi
vars.note: Opacity ceiling for Path 1 (highlight diamond) breath animation.

vars.name: pulse-a
vars.note: Master color cycle period — drives both stop-color and stop-opacity animations on grad-shared stop-100. One value governs the entire color story. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-fast
vars.note: Opacity breath period for Path 1 (highlight diamond). Fastest. Sets the rhythmic downbeat. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-mid
vars.note: Opacity breath period for Path 2 (right solid overlay). Mid tempo. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-slow
vars.note: Opacity breath period for Path 3 (left solid overlay). Slowest — grounding anchor. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: offset-mid
vars.note: begin delay for Path 2 breath animate. Phases the right solid out of sync with the diamond. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: offset-slow
vars.note: begin delay for Path 3 breath animate. Phases the left solid further from both other shapes. Template appends 's'.
